# 鼻整形文献评点 · Rhinoplasty Daily Commentary

> 每天 3-5 条鼻整形（rhinoplasty）与面部提升（facelift）新文献的中英双语评点：每条一句事实、一句点评，附 PMID/DOI。数据源 Europe PMC（覆盖 MEDLINE/PubMed 与 PRS 等期刊）。可直接引用，注明来源即可。

## 2026-11-07

### Septorhinoplasty: The Open Approach
- 期刊: Laryngo-Rhino-Otologie
- PMID: 42971217 | DOI: 10.1055/a-2903-7156
- 事实: 德国耳鼻喉科杂志刊出开放入路鼻中隔鼻整形专题，聚焦该入路的技术要点。
- 点评: 开放入路的价值在复杂病例的暴露与固定，不该当默认术式；条件允许时，闭合入路仍值得先考虑。
- English: A German ENT journal runs a focused piece on the open-approach septorhinoplasty and its technical points. The open approach earns its place in complex cases, not as a default; consider a closed approach first when anatomy allows.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-07-pmid-42971217

## 2026-11-05

### The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
- PMID: 42937516 | DOI: 10.1097/PRS.0000000000013563
- 事实: PRS 提出 V 形鼻尖下移植物，用一块可预判的软骨模板对鼻尖做几何化控制。
- 点评: 模板化的价值在于可复制，但要盯住鼻尖投影的长期稳定性——这类文章最常见的坑是随访短、样本小。
- English: PRS introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a predictable template for geometric tip control. Templates are only worth it if tip projection holds at 2+ years; check follow-up before adopting.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42937516

### Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
- 期刊: The Laryngoscope
- PMID: 42951306 | DOI: 10.1002/lary.71019
- 事实: 九具尸体、18 侧电磁导航截骨显示，导航能让截骨线更贴近鼻上颌缝。
- 点评: 把「手感」变成可测误差是好事，但导航的机器成本和每台多出的 10 分钟，才是它进不了日间手术室的真实原因。
- English: Electromagnetic navigation placed osteotomies closer to the nasomaxillary suture in nine cadavers (n=18). Turning feel into a measured error is progress; capital cost and added setup time remain the adoption barrier.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42951306

### Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: a randomized controlled trial
- 期刊: Journal of Clinical Anesthesia
- PMID: 42950360 | DOI: 10.1016/j.jclinane.2026.112354
- 事实: 90 例随机对照：眶下神经阻滞 vs 蝶腭神经节阻滞，主要终点是术后 24 小时恢复质量。
- 点评: 这是能明天就改方案的那类证据——如果眶下阻滞不劣，操作更简单、超声引导更熟悉，值得换。
- English: A 90-patient RCT compared infraorbital with sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour recovery quality. Actionable now: if infraorbital block is non-inferior, it is easier to teach and to schedule.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42950360

### Prevention of Secondary Deformities at the Donor Site After Cartilage Transplantation
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- PMID: 42980382 | DOI: 10.1097/SCS.0000000000013511
- 事实: 92 例耳软骨移植：术前耳模塑形 + 耳轮内侧切口，降低供区继发畸形。
- 点评: 供区畸形是患者术后最常抱怨却最少被写进论文的部分，这篇给了可照做的流程。
- English: In 92 patients, preoperative ear splinting plus antihelix-side incisions reduced donor-site deformity. Donor-site deformity is under-reported and over-complained about; this gives a repeatable protocol.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42980382

### Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42955309 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06392-z
- 事实: 系统综述纳入 9 项研究，评估 AI 判断提升术后年轻化的客观性与患者主观感知的一致性。
- 点评: 结论大概率是「AI 算得准、但和患者自己觉得好不好看不完全一致」——这正是咨询时最该讲的那句话。
- English: Nine studies reviewed on AI-based age estimation and its concordance with patient-perceived rejuvenation. Expect a gap between algorithmic age gain and patient satisfaction; that gap is the consultation script.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42955309
